title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
task: Code generation, multi-hop QA, and embodied decision-making
supervision: Environment scalar/binary reward and textual execution feedback
memory_scope: Within-episode trial buffer (cleared across episodes in inspected experiments)
exact_overlap: Linguistic self-reflection based on past failure feedback to guide subsequent attempts
difference_to_test: In inspected experiments (Sec. 2-4), Reflexion iterates over multiple trials within the same task instance; FailMem tests cross-task persistent retrieval with precondition gating and environment invalidation

title: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
task: Robot failure explanation and correction planning from multisensory data
supervision: Multimodal sensor streams (video, audio, depth) summarized into text, plus human annotations
backbone: GPT-4 (gpt-4-0314), GPT-3.5 (text-davinci-003) [text LLMs fed hierarchical summaries]
benchmark: RoboFail (AI2-THOR virtual agent: 100 demonstrations; UR5e robot arm tabletop manipulation: 30 demonstrations)
metric: Failure Explanation Accuracy, Correction Planning Success Rate
exact_overlap: Utilizing multimodal robot failure data converted to structured text for failure explanation and replanning
difference_to_test: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-5), REFLECT generates progressive explanations and one-off correction plans for single failed trajectories; in inspected text, no persistent cross-episode memory indexing or spatial costmap invalidation was found

title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
task: Embodied robotic tabletop manipulation and mobile manipulation
supervision: Environment feedback (Success Detector, Passive Scene Describer, Human Feedback)
exact_overlap: Closed-loop planning using environmental perceptual feedback upon failure or state changes
difference_to_test: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-4), Inner Monologue appends detector feedback directly to the ongoing prompt buffer for reactive replanning; in inspected text, no persistent failure memory store or costmap-grounded expiration was found

title: SayPlan: Grounding Large Language Models using 3D Scene Graphs for Scalable Robot Task Planning
task: Large-scale, long-horizon indoor mobile manipulation planning
supervision: 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) state feedback and collision/feasibility verifier
benchmark: Multi-floor indoor environments (up to 3 floors, 36 rooms, 140 objects)
metric: Success Rate, Planning Time, Token Efficiency
exact_overlap: Iterative replanning with semantic scene grounding and feedback upon action failure
difference_to_test: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-4), SayPlan uses a 3DSG simulator for iterative replanning; in inspected text, no persistent episodic failure memory indexing recovery behaviors across distinct episodes was identified

title: Recover
primary_url: Plan: Learning Skills and Concepts from Robot Failures
target_access: Continuous skill learning and abstract concept discovery from robot failures
memory_scope: Reinforcement learning (PPO) reward signals on failure recovery + symbolic predicate induction
benchmark: Abstract predicate and relational skill library
code_url: 4 simulated robotic manipulation domains, Real robot non-prehensile manipulation
license_status: Success Rate, Abstraction Quality, Planning Efficiency
reproduce_or_adapt: Extracting reusable abstractions and recovery behaviors from failure experiences to avoid future failures
blocker: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-5), ReSYNC uses RL and symbolic logic to learn low-level motor skills and relational predicates for tabletop manipulation; FailMem investigates LLM-based navigation failure memory with physical costmap invalidation rules

title: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
task: Lifelong experience reuse for LLM agents across diverse software and interactive environments
memory_scope: Workflow trajectory clusters and skill memory
benchmark: 10 environments (ALFWorld, VirtualHome, ToolBench, WebSearch, Mind2Web, WebArena, etc.)
metric: Task Success Rate, Cross-task Transfer Rate, Forgetting Rate
exact_overlap: Long-term memory accumulating past trajectory experiences and clustering reusable skills to prevent forgetting
difference_to_test: In inspected sections (Sec. 2-4), LifeMem targets software/web and simulated text/embodied tasks via trajectory clustering; in inspected text, no spatial costmap dynamics, physical obstacle persistence, or postcondition verification mechanisms were explored

title: RoboOS-NeXT: A Unified Memory-based Framework for Lifelong
target_access: Lifelong multi-robot collaborative planning and recovery across heterogeneous embodiments
memory_scope: Multi-robot perceptual state streams and shared environment events
code_url: Collaborative scenarios in restaurants, supermarkets, and households
license_status: Team Task Success Rate, Recovery Rate, Coordination Efficiency
reproduce_or_adapt: Using spatio-temporal memory to enable failure recovery and state synchronization in embodied robotics
blocker: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-5), RoboOS-NeXT focuses on multi-robot collaborative scheduling and shared STEM representations; FailMem causally evaluates single-robot failure memory validity boundaries and negative transfer suppression

title: RoboMemory: A Brain-inspired Multi-memory Agentic Framework for Interactive Environmental Learning in Physical Embodied Systems
task: Lifelong interactive environmental learning for embodied agents
supervision: Multi-modal observations and task execution feedback
memory_scope: Multi-memory framework (Working, Spatial, Procedural, Episodic, Semantic memory)
backbone: Tested with Qwen2.5-VL-72b-Ins, Qwen3-Embedding; compared with GPT-4o, Claude3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.0-flash, InternVL-3-72B
metric: Success Rate, Memory Footprint, Ablation Efficiency
exact_overlap: Storing and retrieving episodic and spatial memories across tasks to improve embodied decision-making
difference_to_test: In inspected sections (Sec. 3-4, 4.1.2), RoboMemory evaluates general lifelong memory architectures using VLMs; in inspected text, explicit postcondition verifier isolation and costmap-grounded expiration rules under dynamic layout shifts were not investigated
